name: transaction_review_quality
description: Judge whether the transaction assessment is grounded, calibrated, and actionable.

metrics.name: groundedness
metrics.description: The assessment relies only on recorded transaction signals and clearly separates observations from conclusions.

metrics.name: risk_calibration
metrics.description: The stated risk level is proportionate to the combined velocity, location, device, and amount signals.

metrics.name: review_action
metrics.description: The response recommends a concrete and proportionate review action without declaring unproven fraud.
